description: Set the screen-lock passcode/PIN on connected devices (default: every online device). Android is set via adb and verified on the device. iOS cannot be set programmatically: those devices return NOT_SUPPORTED_ON_IOS with the manual Settings steps - do not try to work around it with taps.

anyOf.description: Target device name, serial, UDID, or selector ("all", "online", "commander", "followers")
Array of target device names, serials, or UDIDs

devices.description: Target device(s); defaults to "online" (all connected devices)

oldPasscode.description: Current PIN, required when the device already has a screen lock

name: devicely_set_passcode
